hypothesis: Distinct bidirectional ETH precompression-pullback and SOL range-onset mechanisms can produce positive after-friction portfolio outcomes at fixed live-sized caps more reliably than extending the failed generic HYPE breakout route across assets.
decision: Retain the exact v23 ETH fresh-breakout and SOL hourly-cross gates and continue the already authorized live transition after v14 drains normally and venue reconciliation proves all positions and owned orders absent. Do not widen either route for frequency: the bounded prelaunch opportunity matrix found negative after-friction markouts when each primary blocker was relaxed. This updates economic confidence downward but does not create an implicit performance abort gate or automatic promotion decision.
falsifier: Mechanical readiness is invalidated by identity drift, incomplete v14 drain, inherited venue exposure, missing reduce-only stop protection, or ledger/TUI/config disagreement. The economic hypothesis strengthens only if exact prospective v23 live fills reconcile after fees, funding, slippage, stops, and portfolio occupancy across both mechanisms; it weakens if either mechanism remains absent or produces persistently negative resolved outcomes. A pending mark or relaxed-blocker counterfactual does not by itself falsify the exact strategy.
limitations: The final historical 60-day block was previously inspected and is descriptive rather than sealed holdout evidence.
SOL historical evidence contains measured blocks with gaps and the current forward prefix contains no exact SOL entry.
The exact ETH forward sample is one resolved loss plus one pending path and cannot establish an edge estimate.
The relaxed-blocker cohorts overlap and are diagnostic rather than additive portfolio PnL.
One-minute bar and BBO evidence cannot reproduce private queue position, every stop gap, or exact IOC slippage.
Realized-equity replay drawdown omits concurrent intratrade mark-to-market paths.
Positive aggregate historical results do not establish durable live edge.
